banner.title: flux-instance
banner.tagline: Declares the Flux controllers this cluster runs, syncs them from Git, and takes a GitHub webhook so pushes reconcile at once.

art.about: a Flux instance that syncs a cluster from Git and listens for webhooks
art.title: How Flux syncs this cluster from Git

explainer.title: From a push on main to a reconcile in seconds

steps.title: Declare
steps.text: The FluxInstance named flux, created by this chart, pins the distribution and the four controllers to run.
steps.scene: a document of code with a gear

steps.title: Sync
steps.text: The source controller pulls kubernetes/clusters/main from main every hour, so Git stays the source of truth.
steps.scene: a branching line converging into a cluster ring

steps.title: Hear
steps.text: GitHub posts a push event through the public gateway. The receiver checks its token and pokes flux-system.
steps.scene: a webhook socket receiving a signal over a gateway arch

steps.title: Tune
steps.text: Patches add workers and memory for the kustomize, helm and source controllers, an in-memory kustomize build and an OOM watch.

steps.title: Watch
steps.text: Four rules fire when the instance is missing or not ready, or a Flux object stays suspended or not Ready too long.
steps.scene: an eye over a ring of synced objects
